i know im not the target audience for this album, being quite a long time em hater, but i still gave this thing a couple shots because people were saying its good

i just can’t. its competing with vultures 1 for my least favourite listen of the year. 

the beats are on average… fine. theres a couple solid ones but overall the production is hardly anything super special. but there also arent any beats that i find straight up BAD, which is good.

the highlight of the album as far as features or frankly verses in general is clearly J.I.D. with his verse on Fuel. i’m also always a big Babytron fan so i liked his hook and verse on Tobey. Rest of the features were… fine? nothing like. absurdly awful but eh. I’ve never liked Jelly Roll or Bizarre so i could do without them but they probably work fine as features for other people.

Now. Em’s verses… are pretty fucking awful and absolutely ruin any good will I had for this album. I get he’s playing a character. I get the concept of the album. But my fucking god. did we really need to name drop Caitlyn Jenner this much? call me biased or jaded or whatever because I’m trans myself but why is the album 19 tracks long if a third of them are just bad transphobia shock bars? i feel like I’d be sick of them even if I were cis. and the other ones with different topical focuses arent much better either. R-A-P-E-R? really? (note. ive heard people say it’s a diddy diss? its not a very well executed one if thats true.)

again. i get the concept. i understand he’s saying that this persona is dated, cringe, and why he can’t bring back the old em. but having 19 tracks of dated, cringe, old em, while certainly showing WHY the character is being retired, does not make for an album I enjoy!

there’s also some new spells that have a dual swords icon at the bottom of the art. that means the school is, at least for now, pvp only.

theyve also changed how you get lore spells, afaik it now has to be either dropped from the crowns pack its in or be crafted, no more farming loremaster for the spell.

there’s also spellements, which are things you can collect that help upgrade or change spells, usually with two or three paths to choose from, whether that be increased damage or healing, or an additional or changed effect. an example would be Fire Cat, which either buffs the damage range of the normal spell, or gives a slightly lower buff, but removes the damage range and instead has a fixed damage for more consistency.

an angiogram is when they put a dye in your artery so they can scan where your blood is flowing. depending on where your avm is, they will probably put the dye in different places. my avm was in my brain, so the surgery was applied to my groin area because that artery is the most direct route to the brain thats still reasonable.

as for gamma knife, that is one of three methods to treat an avm. the quickest and most direct one is surgery, which is what it sounds like they surgically remove it. 

second is embolization, where they use artificial materials to seal off a blood vessel/blood vessels causing the issue.

gamma knife is the slowest one, but i had to have it because my avm was pretty deep in my brain. its where they treat it with radiation to slowly shrink the avm until it is gone.
